subject: Recap + proposed trial runway & owners
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Cho <emma@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: Recap + proposed trial runway & owners

Hi Emma — thanks again for a constructive discovery call today. Quick recap and an action-oriented proposal so we can get the PoC moving next week.

Main goals we agreed on:
- Validate inference quality for BrightPath’s customer-facing summarization flow (5k–20k tokens/day).
- Confirm production latency & cost envelope (P95 latency <= 250ms, cost target <$0.002/token).
- Evaluate integration surface (prefix caching, streaming, and reranking).

Proposed trial runway (please confirm):
- Kickoff: Tue Sep 21, 2026 — 30m technical kickoff (Redwood + BrightPath infra + data owner)
- Week 1 (Sep 22–28): Data ingestion & sample validation — BrightPath to send 3 representative datasets (anonymized) by Sep 23
- Week 2 (Sep 29–Oct 5): Model configs & test harness — Redwood to provision trial capacity, provide baseline throughput tests
- Weekly 30m check-ins (Wednesdays, 09:00 PT) — quick blockers/issues
- Final readout: Tue Oct 12, 2026 — readout + decision rubric review

Ownership (tentative):
- BrightPath: deliver anonymized datasets, success labels, and a product point of contact (POC: Emma).
- Redwood (Rafael): configure trial environment, run baseline latency/throughput tests, produce evaluation report.
- Redwood (Marissa): lead integration support and assist with SOC/compliance questions.
- Redwood (Karthik): engineering owner for quantization/profile suggestions and GPU sizing.

Success criteria (shared):
1) Quality: >= 85% of model outputs meet BrightPath’s relevance threshold on X evaluation set.
2) Latency: P95 <= 250ms for typical 256-token requests under target concurrency.
3) Cost: projected per-token cost <= target and documented in trial cost model.
4) Integration: streaming + prefix caching validated in staging.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (MVP checklist + dates), trial_sow_draft.pdf (SOW draft for signature).

Next steps:
1) Emma — confirm kickoff date (Sep 21 ok?) and send data samples by Sep 23.
2) I’ll update the mutual action plan (attached) and spin up the trial env on Sep 20.
3) If procurement wants a preliminary SOW, the draft is attached; we can route via DocuSign once you sign off.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes | Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
rafael@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0142
From: Emma Cho <emma@brightpath.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed trial runway & owners

Hi Rafael — thanks for the clear summary. This looks good and aligned with our needs. A couple quick notes: 

1) Kickoff: Sep 21 works for us, but could we aim for Sep 14 if Redwood can accelerate setup? We have a release window that would make an earlier readout helpful. If not, Sep 21 is acceptable.
2) Data: I’ll anonymize and drop three sample payloads into the secure S3 link by Sep 23. We’ll also include their expected relevance labels for the evaluation bucket.
3) Procurement wants a SOC2 snapshot and the security questionnaire filled out before we spin up anything. Can Marissa help with that? Our procurement contact is procurement@brightpath.ai.

Also, could you send a short one-pager on the trial metrics we’ll see in the dashboard (latency, tokens, cost-per-call)? That will help our PM and engineering lead.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Cho
Head of Product, BrightPath AI
emma@brightpath.ai
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Cho <emma@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@brightpath.ai
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 09:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed trial runway & owners

Emma — appreciate the quick reply. Two quick items: we can meet Sep 14 but will need the data by Sep 10 to validate ingestion and privacy checks. If BrightPath can deliver by then, we’ll shift kickoff to Sep 14 at 09:00 PT. Otherwise, Sep 21 stands.

Marissa — I’ve looped you in for SOC2 snapshot & security questionnaire (attached in the thread: trial_sow_draft.pdf includes the high-level security appendix). Can you confirm the expected delivery time for the SOC2 evidence and the filled questionnaire?

Per your ask, Emma, I attached a one-page trial-metrics cheat sheet to the mutual_action_plan.xlsx (tab: Dashboards). It covers the live dashboard fields (token counts, per-route P95 latency, streaming percent, cost-per-token) and where to find each metric in Console.

DocuSign: I’ve uploaded the SOW draft to DocuSign for easier routing: https://app.docusign.com/s/ABC-TRIAL-SOW (link). Once procurement confirms, we can sign and start provisioning reserved trial capacity. HubSpot record: HS-12984.

Let me know on data timing and kickoff preference.

Best,
Rafael
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Emma Cho <emma@brightpath.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2026 16:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed trial runway & owners

Looping in a couple of quick clarifications from the security/ops side:
- SOC2: we’ll provide the latest SOC2 Type II summary and the control matrix PDF by Fri Sep 10 (I’ll drop into the secure Drive link).
- Questionnaire: Rafael — can you confirm which subset of the standard security questionnaire BrightPath prefers (full or reduced)? If they want the reduced, we can return it within 48 hours.
- Infra: Karthik — Rafael asked about quantization profiles and GPU sizing. Can you confirm whether the trial will use int8 quantized instances or float16 baseline? Also confirm a conservative GPU booking for the trial week (NVIDIA A10x2 or equivalent) so we can provision.

Emma — we’re set to support either Sep 14 (if data in by Sep 10) or Sep 21 depending on your preference.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Emma Cho <emma@brightpath.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed trial runway & owners

Thanks, all — we’ll stick with Sep 21 kickoff to give our legal/procurement time to review (procurement@brightpath.ai is on copy).

Action items on our side:
- Deliver anonymized datasets + labels to the S3 link by Sep 23.
- Procurement to review SOW; expect sign-off window 1–2 business days after that.

Rafael — please consider the timeline confirmed for Sep 21 at 09:00 PT and send calendar invite. Looking forward to the trial — Emma
